reason: I already have an agency in Tashkent that sits with us in person and costs us nothing, so why would I pay $99 by card to a website I have never heard of? I might let my son try the free search, but I am not putting my card into a foreign site.
objection: Paying in dollars online to an unknown company is risky for us, and I cannot see a real person or office I could go to if something goes wrong.
would_change_my_mind: If the agency's shortlist turned out to be only the universities that pay them commission, and a parent I know said this service found real scholarships for their child, and I could pay locally in sums through Click or Payme.
